{{Top|leg}}
The '''A-1 shuttle''' was a personal shuttle used by many [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was used as a way of transportation from flagships.
